title: Freestanding 4-Arm Swing Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie | Satin Chrome | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage without drilling with this freestanding 4-arm swing towel stand in Satin Chrome, which provides a brushed, matte-like surface that resists fingerprints while maintaining a modern, understated elegance. Four pivoting arms provide space to hang and separate towels, helping you maximize bathroom space.

Highlights:
- Satin Chrome coordinates seamlessly with chrome faucets and fixtures
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction designed to resist rust and corrosion
- Heavy solid brass base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent floor scratching
- Part of the Soho collection for coordinated transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
